analysis: The supplied changes are limited to CHANGELOG.md, with documentation-only text and no executable code, configuration, or mode changes. I read both units (lines 398-608 and 609 onward). The entries describe App Attest recovery, CandidateCDHash matching to durably qualified builds, bounded retries, MDM-optional serving, SSD prefix-cache defaults, and routing and billing changes. These statements are consistent with the base threat model's header notes on TB-011, T-052..T-058, A-015..A-017, and T-041 on the SSD cache. The changelog states that serving and removal stay disabled by default, that revocation and fresh-assertion gates still apply, and that retries never extend authorization. None of the described behaviors weakens a documented mitigation as written. This PR introduces no code-level security regression or new attack surface. The underlying code for the described behaviors, such as the ED-flag-omitted assertion acceptance and the post-refusal serving recovery, is not in this PR. It must be reviewed in the PRs that carry that code. I made no claim about those implementations.
